item.title: Java Testing Frameworks: JUnit 5 vs TestNG vs Spock — Self-Hosted Developer Guide 2026
item.description:
Introduction

Testing is the foundation of reliable software, and Java developers have three mature, production-hardened testing frameworks to choose from: JUnit 5 (the modern standard), TestNG (the feature-rich alternative), and Spock (the expressive Groovy-based framework). Each takes a different philosophical approach to writing, organizing, and executing tests.

item.title: Open Source Java Testing & Assertion Libraries: AssertJ vs Hamcrest vs Google Truth
item.description: Choosing the right assertion library is one of the most impactful decisions a Java developer can make. While JUnit provides basic assertion methods, dedicated assertion libraries offer fluent, readable, and expressive APIs that dramatically improve test quality and developer experience for unit tests.
